notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card exiled with Dino DNA.
You control at least five Dinosaurs.
description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of a creature exiled with it that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
Repeat.
